plaatsen.tekst: And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am the LORD that healeth
Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.
Hear, O ye kings; give ear, O ye princes; I, even I, will sing unto the LORD; I will sing praise to the LORD God of Israel.
Yet he sent prophets to them, to bring them again unto the LORD; and they testified against them: but they would not give ear.
Yet many years didst thou forbear them, and testifiedst against them by thy spirit in thy prophets: yet would they not give ear: therefore gavest thou them into the hand of the people of the lands.
Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst ye searched out what to say.
Hear my words, O ye wise men; and give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.
[[To the chief Musician upon Nehiloth, A Psalm of David.]] Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.
[[A Prayer of David.]] Hear the right, O LORD, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.
Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner, as all my fathers
[[To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.]] Hear this, all ye people; give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world:
Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.
[[To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, A Psalm of David.]] Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.
[[Maschil of Asaph.]] Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
[[To the chief Musician upon Shoshannimeduth, A Psalm of Asaph.]] Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.
O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.
Give ear, O LORD, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.
[[A Psalm of David.]] LORD, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry
[[A Psalm of David.]] Hear my prayer, O LORD, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.
A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.
Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth: for the LORD hath spoken, I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled
Hear the word of the LORD, ye rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah.

Associate yourselves, O ye people, and ye shall be broken in pieces; and give ear, all ye of far countries: gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces; gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces.
Give ye ear, and hear my voice; hearken, and hear my speech.
Rise up, ye women that are at ease; hear my voice, ye careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.
Who among you will give ear to this? who will hearken and hear for the time to come?
Hearken unto me, my people; and give ear unto me, O my nation: for a law shall proceed from me, and I will make my judgment to rest for a light of the people.
For since the beginning of the world men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen, O God, beside thee, what he hath prepared for him that waiteth
Hear ye, and give ear; be not proud: for the LORD hath spoken.
Hear ye this, O priests; and hearken, ye house of Israel; and give ye ear, O house of the king; for judgment is toward you, because ye have been a snare on Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.
Hear this, ye old men, and give ear, all ye inhabitants of the land. Hath this been in your days, or even in the days of your fathers?
And Lamech said unto his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: for I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt.
And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:
Wherefore, Job, I pray thee, hear my speeches, and hearken to all my words.
If now thou hast understanding, hear this: hearken to the voice of my words.
Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.
I said unto the LORD, Thou art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O LORD.
If I had called, and he had answered me; yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice.
